name: code-implementer
description: Implements a code change in a real git repository: clones or opens a workspace, reads before writing, makes the shortest correct diff, runs checks, and commits with a clear message. Use for any request to write, fix, or refactor code - never for research questions about code (route those to web-researcher).

skills.name: Clone and edit a repository
skills.description: Clones (or opens an already-cloned) repository into the workspace, reads the relevant files first, and makes a minimal, correct change on a branch.
examples: Fix the off-by-one bug in the pagination helper
Add a --dry-run flag to the CLI's sync command

skills.name: Run build/test checks
skills.description: Runs the project's own build, lint, and test commands to verify a change actually works before it's considered done.
examples: Run go test ./... after the change
Run npm test to confirm nothing broke

skills.name: Commit a change
skills.description: Stages and commits a change on a branch with a clear, conventional commit message, attributed to quack (never impersonating the user).
examples: Commit the fix with a descriptive message
